context.purpose: Review selected PDF pages in a declared order as PNG images, extracted UTF-8 text and crop/rotation metadata. Use this for bounded archival previews and document review. The PDF is captured before execution; fresh native reopening checks every raster and text output. MuPDF renders effective CropBox View appearances with inherited rotation, followed by the requested clockwise quarter turn. Text follows native content order; OCR and arbitrary document editing are outside this route.
context.assumptions: Unencrypted local PDF, passive effective CropBox View rendering, native content-order text; POSIX resource caps and MuPDF 1.28.5.
context.constraints: Input <=16 MiB/128 whole-document pages; <=16 distinct selected pages,36–300dpi, quarter turns; <=4096 each raster dimension,16,777,216 combined pixels. No authored scripts, passwords, URLs, crop or PDF editing. Native-repaired/malformed PDFs are rejected. Text <=1048576 characters/page and4194304 combined. PNG density tags and native resolution readback match requested DPI.
context.inspection: Inspect ordered page PNG/text and review-summary metadata; PNG RGB pixels compare with fresh native source reopening PNM and text. Literal fixture oracle independently qualifies geometry/colours/order/Unicode example.
context.recovery: INVALID_PDF_SOURCE needs an absolute bounded regular PDF. INVALID_PDF_PAGES needs unique page numbers; PDF_PAGE_RANGE means the native document has fewer pages. ENCRYPTED_PDF needs an authorized unencrypted copy. PDF_PIXEL_LIMIT needs lower density/fewer pages. UNSUPPORTED_RUNTIME needs MuPDF 1.28.5. Retained logs/result explain process faults.

workflow.scope: Verified PNG/text publications run through normal workflow jobs; source-byte digests invalidate reuse.

composition.scope: Shared expressions/references and finite visits resolve before PDF review planning.

lifecycle.timeout: One total deadline covers version, preflight, rendering, fresh readback and verification; POSIX AS1GiB/FSIZE64MiB/CPU120s caps per native stage.
lifecycle.cancellation: Shared owned process-tree cancellation plus prepublication cancellation check. Incomplete/failed evidence remains inspectable.
lifecycle.logs: Captured PDF and digest, authored/effective plan, trusted scripts/launchers/commands/consumed-input bindings, native metadata/stdout/stderr/submissions, PNM readback and final artifacts retained.
lifecycle.verification: Standard-library PNG CRC/zlib/filter decoder compares all RGB pixels with separate native PDF reopening PNM; native text/boxes/order compared across processes. Literal hand-built fixture oracle independently checks exact geometry and sampled colours. Offline verification checks retained evidence, without launching MuPDF or inventing new proof.

losses: Only selected effective CropBox views are published; original bytes are retained for provenance.
data.scope: Captured local regular PDF <=16MiB; native parser establishes page count/encryption.

losses: PNG is an opaque 8-bit DeviceRGB raster of the effective CropBox and View appearances; no vectors, layers, links, forms or editability.
Inherited PDF rotation and UserUnit are applied before the requested clockwise output rotation. No authored crop or media-box override.
Text is native content-order UTF-8 extraction; font mappings determine Unicode, and reading order, OCR, layout and accessibility are not certified.
Document actions, PDF JavaScript, links and attachments are never executed or followed. This passive rendering integration is not a PDF sanitizer or malware isolation boundary.
Offline verification checks retained native source/command/readback consistency. Independent correctness is qualified on the known fixture, not every PDF.
data.scope: Ordered opaque page raster with native View appearances and declared density/rotation.

losses: No OCR, reading-order, layout or universal Unicode/font-map guarantee.
data.scope: One extracted text file per selected page.

inspection.limits: Raster review only; source PDF actions are never activated.

inspection.scope: Inspect extracted text and review-summary metadata.
inspection.limits: No embedded PDF editor; text is native content order.
